description: Open-data profile of one London postcode district: HM Land Registry median sold prices of existing flats and houses (12 months, with sales counts and London figures) and five years of yearly medians, police.uk residential crime per 1,000 residents against London, Ofsted grades of its state schools with the Outstanding ones named, the share of its postcodes in Environment Agency flood zones 2 and 3, council tax bands and ONS official rents for its borough(s), and who lives there (Census 2021 tenure and age, and the share of residents in England's most deprived areas on the Index of Multiple Deprivation 2025). Each block has its window, definition, caveats and source, plus a sentence that keeps them together, and the district page URL to cite.

district.description: A London postcode district (outward code) such as "E17" or "SW11", or a full postcode such as "E17 4QH".

name: get_district_profile
title: London district profile
